WE ARE EXTENDING OUR CAST AND CREW CALL FOR 48 HOURS ONLY!
See information below!

We are looking to film a short horror film for Fresh Meat Horror Film Contest with the consideration we may make this into a feature or YouTube series.

Parameters are a five to ten minute short horror film.

FILM Production: August 12th-19th

in Colorado Springs. 

Producer:

Tamara White, Auteure Films

       

Compensation / Rate: IMDB credit and festival submission. Unpaid. Meals & water.

Note: Zero tolerance set. NO vaping, smoking, alcohol or drugs.

CAST & CREW CALL:

ABOVE THE LINE CREW:

Director

Assistant Director 

Co-Screen Writer to our step outline & dialogue 

BELOW THE LINE CREW:

Film Editor(s)

Production Assistant (PA)

Cinematographers: Director of Photography (DP), 1st AC, 2nd AC.

Grip & Electric: Gaffer, Grip.

Sound Department: Sound Mixer, Boom Operator.

Art Department: Set Designer, Wardrobe, Makeup/SFX

Line Producer-location, schedule, operations manager.

Prop handler

CAST:

3 Actors age 20-30

3 Actresses age 20-30

2 Actor or Actress age 40-60

1 Child Actress (with lines) age 4-6

3 Child Actors ages 4-6

3 Child Actresses age 4-6

Submission Deadline:

AUGUST Fifth !

Casting Director requests email submissions ONLY. 

SUBMISSIONS MUST include: 

ADULT Actors/Actresses:

Resume/CV

Headshot 

Reel or Filmed 2 minute monologue of your choice with slate.

*no Tik Tok video submissions

CHILD actor/actresses:

Resume/CV, headshot & reel.

*If not experienced send a letter of intent with Child’s Name, Age, M/F, and professional or candid Headshot.

**Child Actresses must include video of her saying line - “I’ve been all alone. You’re my best friend now.”

Parental Note: children will be in innocent play not fear nor gore.

Above The Line CREW:

Resume/CV

Headshot 

Reel

Sample script writing, 1 page

Below The Line CREW:

Resume

Headshot 

Video or Photos of your production work, materials, and note what equipment you will contribute.

Cast & Crew submit by the fifth of August at noon to ~

Auteure.casting@gmail.com

**TITLE: "BASED ON A POST"** — Non-Union Short Film

**CASTING:**
Seeking a large ensemble of everyday faces for a series of short vignettes, shot on Kodak 35mm film.

**Roles Available:**
* Teens, playing ages 16–18 (**actor must be 18+**)
* Young Adults, ages 18–25
* Adults, late 20s–40s
* Seniors, 50+

No experience required. We're looking primarily for natural presence, authenticity, and grounded performances. Each performer appears in a brief but featured moment as part of the film's larger story.

**LOCATION:**
Los Angeles, CA, USA (Local hire only)

**COMPENSATION:**
Select roles paid up to **$150**. Other roles are unpaid. All performers receive screen credit and footage for their reel.

**CONTACT:**
**[BasedOnAPost@gmail.com](mailto:BasedOnAPost@gmail.com)**
* To submit, email a recent headshot/photo and any demo reel or performance footage you may have.

**Submission Deadline:** Rolling submissions

**Auditions:** Selected actors will be invited to submit a self-taped audition.

**Production:** Filming over the next **2–3 months**. Each vignette is scheduled individually, with flexible scheduling around cast availability. Most roles are expected to require **one shoot day (up to 4 hou**r**s)**

## CASTING & CREW UPDATE: TRUFFLE PIG (INDIE SHORT FILM)

**ATTENTION DENVER FILM ACTORS & CREW!**

We have a quick casting and production update for our upcoming elevated arthouse body horror/psychological thriller short film, ***Truffle Pig***.

First and foremost, we want to express our **immense gratitude for the overwhelming response**. We have received countless submissions from the community. Reviewing such an incredible pool of talent has been both a true privilege and a remarkably tough selection process—there is so much phenomenal artistry out there!
* **RONNIE:** filled by Randy Rochford
* **EXTRAS/CORPSE:** **FILLED.** Thank you again to everyone who submitted and shared their work; these roles are now officially closed.
* **STILL CASTING:** **the **antagonist, **TYLER**.

If you fit the breakdown below and want to dive into some raw, dark, and visceral material with us, please review the remaining role and submission details!

REVISED CASTING ROLE

**TYLER (Lead | Male, Late-20s–Mid-30s)**
* **Description:** The primary antagonist driving a high-stakes pursuit through the wilderness. Rugged, intimidating, and calculating, Tyler conceals a sinister nature behind a facade of false charm and psychological manipulation. He stalks his target through the night with a shotgun, treating the hunt like a game of control.
* **Requirements:** Complex, intense, and emotionally demanding—requires an actor who isn't afraid to push boundaries into raw, dark, and uncomfortable psychological territory. Must be comfortable with heavy thriller elements, intensity, outdoor night shoots, and SFX makeup & prosthetics/blood work.
CREW & PRODUCTION POSITIONS (SUBMISSIONS UNDER REVIEW)

We are currently reviewing all incoming applications for our key crew and production positions to ensure the best possible fit for the specific stylistic vision and tone of this film:
* **Special Effects (SFX) Makeup Artist:** Specialized in realistic blood, bruising, skin FX, and prosthetics.
* **SFX / Makeup Continuity Supervisor:** To maintain practical/blood alignment across multi-night shoots.
* **Wardrobe Master / Costume Designer:** Managing practical outdoor gear and distressed wardrobe.
* **Gaffer & Lighting Crew:** Experience with low-light, high-contrast night exterior setups.
* **Composer (Music and Sound):** Experience crafting tense, atmospheric, and grounded soundscapes or scores suited for psychological thrillers and arthouse horror.
* **Co-Producers / Executive Producers:** Additional creative/funding partners seeking to attach to an ambitious arthouse horror project. Script and full Pitch Deck Website available upon request for serious inquiries.

*(Note: Crew submissions are actively being evaluated against our creative framework; we will reach out directly as decisions are made.)*
SUBMISSION INFORMATION & DEADLINE
* **Submission Deadline:** August 20th, 2026 by 9:00 AM MST.
* **For Tyler Submissions:** Email your headshot, resume, demo reel, and/or relevant dramatic clips to **randyrochford2@gmail.com** and CC **brock@pioneerentertainment.net** with the subject line: `Tyler - [First/Last Name] - Truffle Pig`.
   * ***Selection Process Note:*** Actors who precisely fit the physical description and creative vision for the character will be moving on to the next round and will receive sides for a self-tape audition. If you are not selected for a self-tape round, please know that we genuinely appreciate your submission; there will be plenty of future opportunities ahead, as the stories in my creative mind are truly endless!
   * ***Self-Tape Slate Requirements (For those advancing):***** **First/Last Name, Height, Location, Representation status, and explicit confirmation that you are comfortable with dark thriller themes, SFX blood/violence, and semi-nude visual elements.
* **For Crew & Production Applicants:** Email your resume, portfolio/website link, and equipment/department list to both emails listed above with the subject line `CREW: [Department Name] - Truffle Pig`.

**PRODUCTION DETAILS:**
* **Compensation:** Paid (NON-UNION), IMDb Credit, Meals/Craft Services provided, and Copy/Footage for reel.
* **Shooting Schedule:** 4–5 Night Shoots in Late July / Early August 2027 (late-night exterior filming).
* **Filming Location:** Mountainous area surrounding Denver, CO.

We truly appreciate your continued enthusiasm and support for independent cinema. We can't wait to see your tapes for Tyler and bring this vision to life!

**CASTING CALL & CREW NOTICE FOR INDIE SHORT FILM **

**TITLE:** Truffle Pig

**GENRE:** Elevated Arthouse Horror / Psychological Thriller / Drama *(Serious, grounded, and intense tone—not campy)*

**LOGLINE:** Hunted through the rugged Colorado wilderness, a man undergoes a harrowing, visceral transformation into a porcine predator to seek karmic retribution. A dark, elevated study on trauma, vengeance, and survival.

**ABOUT THE CREATOR:**

Randy Rochford is a Colorado-based multidisciplinary artist, actor, fashion model, dancer, and writer. He specializes in high-fashion editorial, physical theater, movement, and creature performance. He is the founder of Feelin' Just Dandy Productions, through which he develops original arthouse horror and character-driven thrillers.

**CREATIVE & PRODUCTION TEAM:**
* **Writer / Creative Producer / Casting Director:** Randy Rochford *(Feelin' Just Dandy Productions | Portraying 'Ronnie')*
* **Director / Executive Producer:** Brock Mason Crone *(Pioneer Entertainment)*

**CASTING ROLES:**
* **TYLER (Lead | Male, Late-20s–Mid-30s):** The primary antagonist driving a high-stakes pursuit through the wilderness. Rugged, intimidating, and calculating, Tyler conceals a sinister nature behind a facade of false charm and psychological manipulation. He stalks his target through the night with a shotgun, treating the hunt like a game of control. 🎬 Poszukuję aktorki, kamerzysty oraz makijażystki do teledysku
Do realizacji autorskiego teledysku poszukuję osób, które chciałyby wziąć udział w wyjątkowym projekcie filmowo-muzycznym.

👩 Aktorka

Poszukuję kobiety:

wiek 24–31 lat,

wzrost do 175 cm,

preferowana szatynka o zielonych oczach,

naturalny wygląd,

umiejętność tańca będzie wymagana (sceny taneczne stanowią część teledysku),

doświadczenie aktorskie nie jest wymagane.

Poszukuję osoby, która dobrze czuje się przed kamerą i potrafi przekazywać emocje bez dialogów.

🎥 Kamerzysta

mile widziane doświadczenie przy teledyskach lub filmach,

własny sprzęt będzie dodatkowym atutem.

💄 Makijażystka

Mile widziana osoba z doświadczeniem lub pasją do makijażu i stylizacji.

O projekcie

Teledysk powstaje do autorskiej piosenki. Zdjęcia będą realizowane w plenerze (plaża, las, rzeka oraz o wschodzie słońca). Projekt opiera się na symbolice, emocjach i choreografii – bez dialogów.

📍 Lokalizacja: okolice Tychów / Pszczyny.

📅 Termin zdjęć: do ustalenia.

Uwagi

Preferowana ciemnogranatowa (ciemnoniebieska) sukienka do kolan.

Szczegóły scenariusza otrzyma wybrana aktorka.

Można zgłaszać również znajomych lub polecić osobę, która mogłaby pasować do roli.

Współpraca odbywa się na zasadach TFP (Time For Portfolio). Przed rozpoczęciem zdjęć zostanie podpisana umowa TFP oraz zgoda na wykorzystanie wizerunku.

Projekt realizowany jest hobbystycznie na zasadach TFP. Materiał będzie publikowany w mediach społecznościowych oraz serwisach muzycznych.

📩 Osoby zainteresowane proszę o wiadomość prywatną wraz z krótką informacją o sobie oraz aktualnym zdjęciem (lub portfolio).

# 🎬 CASTING DO PEŁNOMETRAŻOWEGO FILMU FABULARNEGO [NON-PROFIT]

Do niezależnego filmu autorskiego poszukujemy aktorów (zarówno profesjonalistów, jak i osób bez doświadczenia aktorskiego o wyrazistej aparycji) **z Krakowa i okolic**.

📅 **Zdjęcia:** koniec sierpnia – wrzesień 2026
🎥 Zdjęcia realizowane głównie w weekendy. Lokacje znajdują się zarówno w Krakowie, jak i poza miastem.
🚗 **Zapewniamy transport z Krakowa na plan zdjęciowy i z powrotem.**
🍲 Na planie zapewniamy ciepły obiad oraz przyjazną, twórczą atmosferę.
## Poszukujemy:
1. Głuchoniemego mężczyzny

Wiek około **25–45 lat**.

Szukamy osoby o wyrazistej mimice i naturalnej ekspresji. To niewielka, ale bardzo ważna i zapadająca w pamięć rola.
2. Trójki starszych osób do scen w wiejskiej kawiarni

**• Henryk**
70–85 lat. Spokojny starszy mężczyzna o charakterystycznej twarzy. Mile widziane wąsy.

**• Starsza kobieta nr 1**
70–85 lat. Ciepła z wyglądu, z silnym charakterem i subtelnym poczuciem humoru.

**• Starsza kobieta nr 2**
70–85 lat. Bardziej stanowcza, przenikliwa, z ironicznym usposobieniem. Szukamy twarzy z historią.
3. Starsza pani z jabłkami

Wiek **75+**.

Niewielka, ale bardzo ważna scena o filozoficznym charakterze. Szukamy osoby z naturalnością, ciepłem i wewnętrzną głębią.
4. Stara Amalia

Wiek **75–90 lat**.

Jedna z najważniejszych ról drugoplanowych filmu. Finałowa, bardzo emocjonalna scena. Szukamy aktorki potrafiącej przekazać mądrość, czułość i całe przeżyte życie poprzez subtelną obecność przed kamerą.

🎥 **Projekt non-profit.**

Nie szukamy idealnej urody. **Szukamy twarzy z historią.**

Jeśli chcesz wziąć udział w tym projekcie, wyślij na **wegototheseafilm@gmail.com**:

• imię i nazwisko oraz wiek,
• aktualne zdjęcia (portret i cała sylwetka),
• jeśli posiadasz – link do showreela lub wideowizytówki,
• miejscowość zamieszkania oraz numer kontaktowy.

Będziemy wdzięczni za każde udostępnienie. Być może dzięki Tobie znajdziemy naszych bohaterów.

We’re incredibly excited to welcome national treasure Cheryl Fergison to the (fully air-conditioned) Two Brewers in Clapham tomorrow, Wednesday 12th August 2026.

Cheryl joins Andrew Keates for a night exploring her whole life and career. You can expect huge laughs, inspiring insights into the many challenges she’s faced and of course - plenty of heart, plus the chance to have Cheryl sign her autobiography afterwards with her son, Alex.

There are only 100 seats, tickets are only £15. Come and escape the heat for this night with a national treasure.

SUPPORTING ARTISTES WANTED FOR THE N.E.S.T. PROJECT!

We are looking for enthusiastic supporting artistes to join us for our upcoming filming scenes.

This is an incredible opportunity to step onto a real film set, experience the world of filmmaking, and become part of a growing independent feature film production.

Whether you are looking to gain on-set experience, develop your skills, meet like-minded creatives, or simply be part of something exciting, this is your chance.

By joining us, you will gain:

Real on-set experience
The opportunity to network with cast and crew
Insight into professional filmmaking processes
The chance to develop your understanding of how a production works
A unique experience being part of an ambitious feature film project

No previous experience is required. We are looking for people with enthusiasm, commitment, and a willingness to get involved.

N.E.S.T. is more than just a film; it is a community of creatives coming together to build something ambitious. We would love for you to be part of the journey.

If you are interested in joining us, reach out to find out more information.

info@emberproduction.com

￼ The role may be temporary. The relationship with themselves last much longer.

Hello friends !
I’m excited to share that I’m offering two theater classes on Outschool this fall !

As a working actress, educator, and stagehand—and a former homeschooled theater kid myself—I know how meaningful theater education can be. It builds confidence, creativity, communication skills, and, of course, it’s a lot of fun!

🎭 Intro to Acting Game Day – August 19

This one-time class is a great way for students to explore drama through games and activities. It’s a fun, low-pressure introduction to acting and a perfect way to see if they’d enjoy taking more theater classes.

https://outschool.com/classes/improv-game-day-WX6EyF1y?usid=5PyF5mWM&signup=true&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=educator_share_activity_link

🎬 Fundamentals of Acting – Starts August 31

This 8-week course covers the fundamentals of acting in a supportive, encouraging environment where students can build skills and confidence week by week.

https://outschool.com/classes/the-fundamentals-of-acting-hyhzDrbo?usid=5PyF5mWM&signup=true&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=educator_share_activity_link

✨ Use my coupon code LHARRDRAMA5 to get $5 off any of my classes!

If you know a homeschool family, a young performer, or a kid who’s been curious about theater, I’d love it if you’d share this post with them. Thanks so much for your support!

On-Camera Host / Narrator — Military, Aviation & Geopolitics YouTube Channel (Remote)

Lookup Media produces fast-paced video content on military technology, aviation, and world affairs for a growing YouTube audience. We're hiring an on-camera host to present our videos — the voice and face that makes our stories land. If you're a natural in front of a camera and can make a written story sound compelling, we want to see you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Present scripted video content (military tech, aviation, geopolitics) on camera as our host

- Deliver our scripts with energy, clarity, and authority — engaging, not stiff

- Record remotely from your own setup on a regular schedule

- Work with our writers on tone and pacing

- Occasionally record voiceover and short-form (Shorts) segments

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- A confident, mature on-screen presence with a commanding, trustworthy delivery

- A strong, clear speaking voice and natural comfort on camera

- Reliable turnaround and openness to direction

- Interest in military, aviation, or geopolitics is a real plus

- Prior hosting, presenting, broadcast, narration, or acting experience welcome (not required if the presence is there)

NICE TO HAVE

- Your own camera, lighting, and mic for quality remote recording

- Background in broadcasting, public speaking, or content creation

COMPENSATION

- [Per-video rate / monthly retainer]

- Fully remote, flexible recording schedule

- Ongoing work as the channel grows

HOW TO APPLY

Follow the link below for a short audition brief and a sample script to record as your self-tape. Send your finished self-tape and a brief note on your experience to hiring@lookupmedia.co

We review on a rolling basis and reach out to strong fits quickly — apply today.

Audition brief & sample script: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1GIS5v6a84mCFJnK3KfZBiVArzNklMNPrwG3ewS8lL0U/edit?usp=sharing

items.text:
🎬 CAST & CREW CALL — (Short Film) — Pueblo / Colorado Springs

Moonstream Pictures is casting a short comedy thriller shooting in the Pueblo / Colorado Springs area.

THE FILM: Kaylee, 22, just got fired and rent was due Tuesday. Her best friend tells her about an app — contract work, pick your own jobs, pays same night.

ROLES (both female, 18–25):

KAYLEE — LEAD. Warm, funny, a little in over her head. Starts the movie treating a threatening message like a customer service call and ends it somewhere very different.

BRITT — SUPPORTING LEAD. Kaylee's best friend. Knows more than she's saying. Quiet, level.

No experience required. If you've done a little acting, a lot of acting, or nothing at all and you've just always wanted to try — audition.

CREW — COME LEARN ON SET:

This is a set for people who want to do the job, not fetch coffee while somebody else does it. Everybody gets hands on gear.

MAKEUP / SFX — everyday looks plus practical blood effects. Messy, fun, and we'll walk you through it.

GRIP — rigging, stands, flags, moving and shaping light. The best crash course in how a set actually works.

SOUND — boom operator / location recordist. Hugely in demand and almost nobody in this area does it well. Learn it and you'll never be out of work.

ANY OTHER ROLE YOU'VE BEEN WANTING TO TRY — camera assistant, script supervisor, gaffer, production assistant, editor, BTS photographer. If there's a job on a film set you've been curious about and can't get anyone to let you try, tell me which one. We'll find a way to put you in it.

You do not need experience, gear, or a reel. You need to show up on time and be willing to learn. Everyone's a first-timer once, and this is a good place to be one.

THE DEAL — please read:

Unpaid.

Food and gas covered for every shoot day.

Full credit on the film and IMDb.

Footage for your reel, plus a copy of the finished short.

Small crew, short days, genuinely fun set. Meet some good people and network.

SCHEDULE: Shoot dates are still being set. Since this is a low-budget volunteer production, we'll do our best to build the schedule around what works for the people who sign on — jobs, school, and all of it. Tell us your availability and we'll work with it.

CONTENT NOTE: The film contains intense scenes, stage blood, and a physical struggle between the two leads. Nothing sexual, nothing nude. Choreographed and rehearsed, safety first, always. Please only apply if you're comfortable with that material — happy to talk through it before you commit.

TO APPLY: Reach out with a photo, your age, and anything you've done (or "nothing yet," which is a perfectly good answer as long as you can record yourself with a phone doing some auditions). Sides available for audition on request.

📩 Message me here on Facebook

📷 Instagram: @moonstreampics

✉️ Email: moonstreampictures@gmail.com

Full script available to anyone who's seriously interested.

KLEINDARSTELLERIN ÜBER 60 GESUCHT

Wir (UdK-Studentin, Mediengestalter Bild und Ton) suchen noch eine Kleindarstellerin für unseren Kurzspielfilm

„Danke, ich." Er soll beim KURZstummfilmfestival eingereicht werden.

Es handelt sich um einen Stummfilm mit dem Thema „blau".

Ein Drehbuch ist schon vorhanden.

Im besten Fall hast du BLAUE oder GRÜNE AUGEN und GRAUE HAARE (teilweise grau oder weiß ist auch in Ordnung)

SPIELALTER: ÜBER 60 (je älter, desto besser)

Ja es eine No-Budget-Produktion ist, können wir leider keine Gage anbieten. Für Verpflegung am Set ist gesorgt. Dafür eine Menge Spaß ein nettes Team und ein Drehtag in der Natur  Der Film soll Mitte September, voraussichtlich am 12./13.09. in Berlin gedreht werden.

Schick uns bei Interesse gerne hier eine Nachricht oder eine Email an juli.c1@gmx.de. Dann senden wir dir weitere Informationen zum Projekt. Wir freuen uns, von dir zu hören!

:)

Julia Collina

**CASTING CALL **

We’re looking for a German actor (fluent in English) for a short mini-series filming in **Vilnius, Lithuania, on August 14–15**.

The project is a **tourism campaign for social media (Instagram Reels & TikTok).**

**About the project:**
The story follows three university friends from different countries who decide to get away for a weekend in Vilnius. The series shows their adventures and experiences during the trip.

**Role:**
**Hans – an artist from Berlin**
German, fluent in English.

If you’re interested or know someone who could be a good fit, please send me a DM with your **photos, showreel/acting experience and contact details**.

Feel free to share with anyone who might be interested.

items.text: Hi, I'm Aaron. I'm local to Blackpool and I've become really interested in getting involved in film, particularly military, action and horror projects. I have no professional acting experience, but I've got a NATO-style military outfit and I've done several zombie survival/shooting experiences. I'm very comfortable performing in that sort of environment and I'd love the opportunity to play a soldier or background military character in a student film or short film. I'm happy to consider unpaid student projects to gain experience. If any students are looking for actors/extras for projects, I'd really appreciate being considered. 🫡 🖖

🏨 LOOKING FOR QUALITY ENTERTAINMENT FOR YOUR HOTEL OR CORPORATE EVENT?
At Compañía de Variedades Gálatas, we are the artistic ally your business needs. We don't offer a simple show—we offer an experience that builds guest loyalty, elevates your brand, and generates visual content your clients will share on social media. 🎭✨

---

🎪 What can we do for your company?

✅ Nightly shows for hotels and resorts – Variety shows featuring magic, clowning, juggling, and physical comedy. Perfect for adult and family audiences.

✅ Street parades and roaming entertainment – Stilt walkers, giant puppets, and larger-than-life characters that activate pools, lobbies, and common areas.

✅ Thematic ambiance for buffets, gala dinners, and bar areas – Handcrafted scenography and performances that turn a meal into an unforgettable visual experience.

✅ Activations for corporate events, trade fairs, and product launches – We attract attention, generate photos, and create moments that connect with your audience.

✅ Custom characters and mascots – We design any character your hotel or brand needs for campaigns and promotions.

✅ Total flexibility – We adapt to your spaces, schedules, and needs. We create custom setups based on your requirements.

---

🏆 Why is Gálatas your best choice?

🎭 10 years of uninterrupted track record in the Cuban tourism sector.

🏨 We work with the best hotel chains: Meliá Hotels International, Grupo Gaviota, Blue Diamond Hotels & Resorts, Blau Hotels & Resorts, Barceló Hotel Group, and Iberostar Hotels & Resorts.

🎪 Participation in key events: FIT 2025 and 2026 (Cuba's International Tourism Fair), Gourmet Varadero Fair 2025 and 2026, and the International Street Theater Festival 2025.

🎨 In-house craftsmanship – We design and manufacture our own costumes, props, and sets. This allows us to customize any theme without relying on external suppliers.

🌍 Universal language – Our specialty is mime and pantomime. We don't use words. A guest from any country understands and enjoys our show. This removes barriers and expands your reach.

🤝 Professional team of 6 people – Versatile, disciplined, and experienced in the demanding pace of a resort.

---

📊 Benefits for your business:

✔️ Higher guest satisfaction – Quality entertainment is one of the top-rated factors in hotel surveys.

✔️ Social media content – Our characters and shows generate photos and videos that your guests share, giving you organic visibility.

✔️ Differentiation from competitors – A unique, high-level artistic offering positions your hotel as a premium destination.

✔️ Guest loyalty – Guests remember emotional experiences. And we are experts at creating emotions.

---

📅 How do we get started?

We are available to:

📩 Send you our complete artistic portfolio (photos, videos, technical sheets, and references).

🎥 Hold a virtual meeting to present our proposal in detail.

📝 Adapt our shows for 1‑, 3‑, or 6‑month seasons.

✈️ Travel with all documentation in order and immediate availability.

---

📩 Contact us now and let's talk about how we can collaborate.

📱 WhatsApp: +53 5 2030860

📧 Email: luise9209@nauta.cu

📸 Instagram/TikTok: @lianet_valero

📍 Matanzas, Cuba

---

🎭 Gálatas – Building smiles and reaching hearts through art.

Because entertainment is not an expense—it's an investment that multiplies your clients' experience.

SOME TRADITIONS DESERVE TO BE PRESERVED.

For centuries, the circus has been part of the world’s cultural and performing arts heritage — an extraordinary combination of theater, athleticism, artistry, music, courage, and human imagination.

That tradition comes alive under the Garden Bros Circus Big Top.

For more than three generations, our family has dedicated itself to preserving and advancing the art of the American circus — creating a stage where remarkable artists can perform their craft before a live audience.

Just as we support our theaters, orchestras, dance companies, museums, and other cultural institutions, we believe the circus deserves a place in our cultural future.

Come experience an art form that cannot be recreated on a screen.

See it live. Celebrate the artists. Preserve the tradition.

Hey everyone, we’re a small group of filmmakers looking to cast 2 roles in a micro short. I’ve popped details below: 

Overview: A 2-minute micro-short about an AI evangelist arrogantly pitching a pointless product to his colleague at lunch. 

ROLES:

AI EVANGELIST: 

Gender: Male

Age: 25-35 looking

Persona: Increasingly manic, corporate, vaguely arrogant, lacks self awareness. 

SHOWREEL: this role requires one long monologue, so please callout in your DM if your showreel contains a monologue. 

COWORKER:

Gender: Female

Age: 25-35 looking

Persona: Expressive, left behind at lunch with the Evangelist, trying to be polite but desperately looking for a way out.

Availability: Afternoon/Evening of either Friday 21st or 28th August. 

Location: West London

Travel expenses only, but will be a quick shoot. Food provided on set. 

If you or anyone you know fits the bill, please DM me your Spotlight/Showreel. 

Thanks all :)

Data: 19.08
Stawka: 700 zł netto za całość

Chętny Panów zapraszam do wysyłania PILNYCH zgłoszeń na adres: casting.outset@interia.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila proszę o wpisanie nazwy postaci.

CASTING CALL FOR PROOF OF CONCEPT SHORT FILM

Are you a collaborator, ready for an opportunity? If you’re ready to take a leap to do something you’ve always wanted to do, with someone ready to give you that chance, THIS is the movie for you. I’m seeking dynamic, smart, funny cast members to shoot  a comedy scene from my feature, Cheddar Pop. 

“Cheddar Pop, is an independent, privately funded, feature that I wrote and will be producing from the ground up this year. It’s a comedy about a group of young movie theater workers who learn to rely on themselves and each other as they attempt to unionize their workplace.”

Feature Film: “Cheddar Pop”
Location: Greater Parker, CO. Area

Shoot Dates: September 1, 2026 must be available for rehearsals week of August 21-28. 

Project Type: Independent Feature Film (non-union, yes, we get the irony here)

Compensation: Unpaid, meals provided. 

Genre: Comedy

Logline: A group of theater employees find solidarity as they attempt to unionize their workplace and return to what made Cheddar’s Cinema a great place to work. Taking a stand at the concessions stand!

4 roles available. 2 female 2 male ages 18-25, Any level of experience. 

GEORGIA – Age 22—Theater Crew
Disgruntled and disillusioned, Georgia is stuck in a job that used to be her dream but now is draining her of all enthusiasm.

STELLA – Age 21—Theater Crew
Georgia’s best friend and greatest champion. Bubbly, energetic, and enthusiastic.

ROBBIE—Age 21—Theater Crew
Took a job at the theater for summer at the same time as his friend Kevin. The money’s okay for now, but always looking for something better. Just passing time.

KEVIN—Age 19—Theater Crew
Robbie’s best friend. Loves working at the theater because it keeps him close to his first passion, movies.

Email cheddarpopmovie@gmail.com for sides and Audition Notes. Submissions due by August 14, 2026.

topComments.text: I'm definitely interested, but I'm 28. I got mistaken a lot for a 19-23 years old person though

Calling all Colorado filmmakers! We are hitting the road and bringing the community together for an epic series of events stretching across the Front Range, starting in Boulder, moving to Denver, heading down to Colorado Springs, and ending in Pueblo. Whether you are a director, cinematographer, actor, screenwriter, editor, composer, etc or even a business looking to hire a talented videographer, these events are where you need to be for networking and meeting new people. Make sure to mark your calendars! A massive thank you to our incredible venue partners; Rayback Collective, Blend.Co, and The Brit Pub—for hosting us and supporting local talent. Make sure to stay tuned, as we will be announcing the official location for our Kick Ass X-Mas Party in Pueblo. 

#kickassfilmfest #networking #coloradofilm #colorado #creative

Aufruf für ein Theaterstück – Titel: „Hauptdarsteller“
Hallo zusammen,

wir beginnen bald mit den Proben für ein neues Theaterstück. Wir proben im Theaterhaus Mitte und planen eine Aufführung im Acud.

Das Stück trägt den Titel „Hauptdarsteller“ und ich suche noch Schauspielerinnen und Schauspieler, die Interesse haben, Teil dieser Produktion zu werden.

Bei Interesse schicke ich euch das Stück gerne zu.

Ein erstes Treffen können wir organisieren, sobald wir ein Team von ungefähr 5–10 Schauspieler*innen zusammengestellt haben.

Ich bin ausgebildete Theater- und Filmregisseurin (HFF) und habe unter anderem an der Volksbühne gearbeitet. Es ist eine professionelle Produktion mit professionellen Schauspieler*innen und professioneller Regiearbeit.

Die Produktion ist zunächst ohne Bezahlung geplant, allerdings können die Einnahmen aus den Eintrittsgeldern am Ende natürlich unter den Beteiligten aufgeteilt werden.

Geplant ist, am Anfang einmal pro Woche zu proben und die Proben später auf zwei- bis dreimal pro Woche zu erweitern.

Bei Interesse meldet euch gerne bei mir.

Liebe Grüße

Lydia

01783230952

eistvpro@gmail.com

----

Call for Actors – Theatre Production “Hauptdarsteller”

Hello everyone,

we will soon begin rehearsals for a new theatre production. We will rehearse at Theaterhaus Mitte and are planning a performance at Acud.

The play is called “Hauptdarsteller” and I am currently looking for actors and actresses who would like to become part of this production.

If you are interested, I would be happy to send you the script.

We will arrange a first meeting once we have assembled a team of approximately 5–10 actors.

I am a trained theatre and film director (HFF) and have, among other things, worked at Volksbühne. We are creating a professional production with professional actors and professional directing work.

The production is initially unpaid, but ticket revenue can of course be shared among the participants at the end.

The plan is to rehearse once a week at the beginning and later increase rehearsals to two or three times per week.

If you are interested, please feel free to contact me.

Best wishes,

Lydia

01783230952

eistvpro@gmail.com

## *“When I’m acting sometimes I get in my own way.”*

We ask every actor the same question:

"What's standing in your way?"

One actor wrote,

*"I think it's myself in some ways."*

Another wrote,

*"Fear of failure and rejection."*

They're not alone.

Most actors know exactly what happens in auditions. Fear creeps in, confidence disappears, and suddenly they're playing it safe instead of telling the truth.

Safe choices rarely get remembered.

In Tuesday's free class, we'll show you how to work with your nerves (not against them) so you can trust yourself, make fearless choices, and walk into your next audition with freedom instead of fear.

**Schauspieler / Kleindarsteller aus Hamburg sucht neue Projekte**

Hallo,

mein Name ist **Nicolay Bein**, ich bin **41 Jahre alt**, **1,94 m groß** und komme aus **Hamburg**.

Ich suche Einsätze als **Schauspieler, Kleindarsteller oder Komparse** für Film-, Fernseh-, Serien-, Werbe-, Musikvideo- oder Imagefilmproduktionen.

Ich konnte bereits **erste Erfahrungen als Komparse bei einem Filmdreh sammeln**. Diese Erfahrung hat meinen Wunsch, als Schauspieler vor der Kamera zu arbeiten, noch weiter bestärkt. Ich bin motiviert, zuverlässig, pünktlich und arbeite gerne im Team.

Durch meine Größe und mein markantes Erscheinungsbild eigne ich mich unter anderem für Rollen als Sicherheitsmitarbeiter, Polizist, Handwerker, Geschäftsmann, Türsteher oder andere charakterstarke Figuren.

Die Bezahlung richtet sich nach der jeweiligen Produktion und Rolle. Ich freue mich über faire und seriöse Angebote und bin sowohl für einzelne Drehtage als auch für längerfristige Projekte offen.

Anfragen aus **Hamburg** und dem gesamten Bundesgebiet sind herzlich willkommen.

Ich freue mich auf Ihre Nachricht und sende Ihnen auf Wunsch gerne aktuelle Fotos sowie weitere Informationen.

**Viele Grüße**

Nicolay Bein

THERE’S STILL TIME!!

CASTING CALL FOR PROOF OF CONCEPT SHORT FILM

Are you a collaborator, ready for an opportunity? If you’re ready to take a leap to do something you’ve always wanted to do, with someone ready to give you that chance, THIS is the movie for you. I’m seeking dynamic, smart, funny cast members to shoot  a comedy scene from my feature, Cheddar Pop. 

“Cheddar Pop, is an independent, privately funded, feature that I wrote and will be producing from the ground up this year. It’s a comedy about a group of young movie theater workers who learn to rely on themselves and each other as they attempt to unionize their workplace.”

Feature Film: “Cheddar Pop”

Location: Parker, CO.

Shoot Dates: September 1, 2026 must be available for rehearsals week of August 21-28. 

Project Type: Independent Feature Film (non-union, yes, we get the irony here)

Compensation: Unpaid, meals provided. 

Genre: Comedy

Logline: A group of theater employees find solidarity as they attempt to unionize their workplace and return to what made Cheddar’s Cinema a great place to work. Taking a stand at the concessions stand!

4 roles available. 2 female 2 male ages 18-25, Any level of experience. 

GEORGIA – Age 22—Theater Crew
Disgruntled and disillusioned, Georgia is stuck in a job that used to be her dream but now is draining her of all enthusiasm.

STELLA – Age 21—Theater Crew
Georgia’s best friend and greatest champion. Bubbly, energetic, and enthusiastic.

ROBBIE—Age 21—Theater Crew
Took a job at the theater for summer at the same time as his friend Kevin. The money’s okay for now, but always looking for something better. Just passing time.

KEVIN—Age 19—Theater Crew
Robbie’s best friend. Loves working at the theater because it keeps him close to his first passion, movies.

Email cheddarpopmovie@gmail.com for sides and Audition Notes. Submissions due by August 14, 2026.

SEEKING MULTIPLE ROLES FOR EXCITING INDEPENDENT SHORT FILM
Shooting 10/27-10/30 outside Denver, CO

Synopsis-
> A group of teenage girls find themselves on the brink of womanhood, navigate their friendship in rural Colorado. Short film project, aimed at festival submissions. 

Copy this link to our PITCH DECK for additional information about the project- [https://canva.link/oh41j2ip3nlde5t](https://canva.link/oh41j2ip3nlde5t?fbclid=IwcGRvZgFleHRuA2FlbQIxMABicmlkETBWd25xRHJDamdUdXVxNjMzc3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABHgYs8oK2v3EZ93riEAVTyB4RghOOAaHqGV3ojNFC4jFsHaj_42hlRX1P8C1G_aem_66dEW0ctSFD8IrB5obQZaw)

Talent MUST be 18+ and able to work local to Denver to apply.

*** All roles are unpaid but talent will receive copy, credit, and meals.**

Currently Seeking NON-UNION talent

Crocco 

*White. 25 years old*. Will lure you in, the same way crocodiles will stick their hands up in a body of water - convincing you it’s a person needing saving, only to attack when you’re at your most vulnerable. Charming. Charismatic. (Performance Reference: Lewis Pullman as Owen Taylor in The Starling Girl)

*Diesel*

*Not white. 23 years old.* Lover boy. Flirtatious. Can be wrapped around your finger when sex is on the table, otherwise you don’t exist. (Performance Reference: Shaun Thomas as Badger in How To Have Sex, Shia Labeouf as Jake in American Honey)

Tip

*Any race. 24 years old.* Along for the ride. Epitome of cool. Laid back. Too forgiving and understanding. Fiercely loyal to his friends. (Performance Reference: Angus Cloud as Fezco in Euphoria)

If interested, please email [maggotscasting@gmail.com](mailto:maggotscasting@gmail.com) with a headshot, resume, and reel (any footage of yourself will do!).

✨ **WE’RE HOLDING OPEN AUDITIONS!** ✨

For the first time in forever, Pixie Dust Parties is holding an** open audition**, looking for enthusiastic, talented performers to join our team of character entertainers across **Bath, Bristol & the South West**!

We’re looking for performers who can bring beloved characters to life and create genuinely magical experiences for children and families. We run several events, and shows, throughout the year, from family events to scripted musical performances. Our performers may also be booked for birthday parties, community events, weddings, corporate events, school visits and other special occasions.

**THE ROLE**

Depending on the character/event, our performers may:
Perform as a princess or character
Perform in scripted seasonal shows
Meet and greet with guests
Sing and lead songs
Dance and teach simple dances
Tell stories and lead interactive activities
Pose for photos and interact with guests
Stay in character throughout the experience
Create a fun, welcoming and memorable experience for every guest

The great thing about being a Pixie Dust Character Performer is that you choose which events you work, and when. No one is expected to attend every event, but equally you can accept as much work as you like!

**WE ARE LOOKING FOR PEOPLE WHO:**

Are confident performers with experience in **acting, **with singing experience preferred (but not required.) 
Are genuinely enthusiastic about working with children
Are comfortable improvising and thinking on their feet
Have a warm, energetic and engaging personality
Can confidently interact with groups of children and parents
Are reliable, professional and punctual
Have some availability for **weekends and school holidays**
Have their own transport or are reliably able to travel to bookings around the South West

Previous professional experience is a bonus, but not essential. We’re much more interested in your performance ability, personality and potential! ✨

You don’t need to look exactly like a particular character either. We’re interested in performers who can capture the **spirit, personality and magic** of the characters we portray. 💕

**THE AUDITION**

We’re holding **open auditions in Bath**, and we’d love to meet performers who think they could be a great fit for the team.

If you’re a performer who loves Disney, theatre, storytelling, singing, dancing and making little princess lovers absolutely lose their minds with excitement, **this might be for you** 👀

Fill in our audition form to register your interest and we’ll be in touch with the audition details!

**SIGN UP HERE **👇
https://forms.gle/JttzkpVYhm5UHPJNA

✨ **Come join the magic!** ✨

**Audition Notice:**

**"Little Shop of Horrors" presented by First Impressions Theatre**

**Audition Dates**:
* Monday September 7th @ 6:30pm 4942 Fraser street at 33rd
* Wednesday September 9th @ 6:30pm 4942 Fraser Street at 33rd
* Monday September 14th @ 6:30pm in Deep Cove 4360 Gallant Avenue

**Production Rehearsal Start Date: **January 2nd 2027

**Submission email:** ad@firstimpressionstheatre.com  **                                                                                                             **

**Performance Dates:**
* Deep Cove February 18th to March 6th (Wednesdays to Saturdays)
* Chilliwack May 8th 
* Coquitlam May 10-15th

**What to prepare for the audition:**

Auditionees will be asked to bring in one 1-2 minute comedic monologue and one song (audition cut please!) of their own choosing ***not from Little Shop*** that they believe **best showcases their abilities**, additionally, please prepare a cutting from below based on role preference. *****Music will be emailed to you when you submit via email*****

                                                                         

**Skid Row Bars 1-21**

**Be A Dentist, bars 42-69**

**Suddenly Seymour bars 32-56**

**                                                                            **

**Contact name:** Claude Giroux

**Submit to:** ad@firstimpressionstheatre.com

**Phone Number:** 604-328-0721

**Company Website:** www.firstimpressionstheatre.com

**Pay: **Non-union, all actors will receive a stipend 

                                          

**FIT** is committed to diversity and we encourage all artists to submit, and to self identify if they so choose. We welcome submissions from artists with a broad range of backgrounds including, but not limited to race, ethnicity, Indigeneity, gender, gender- identification, sexual orientation, class and physical ability. If there are any barriers (language, disability, or any other considerations) preventing you from submitting, please let us know and we will work with you to overcome them.

**Additional Information:** Little Shop of Horrors Music Direction by Jenaya Barker. Choreographed by Alice Battista. Directed by Claude Giroux. 

**Production Description:** The meek floral assistant Seymour Krelborn stumbles across a new breed of plant he names "Audrey II" - after his coworker crush. This foul-mouthed, R&B-singing carnivore promises unending fame and fortune to the down and out Krelborn as long as he keeps feeding it, BLOOD. Over time, though, Seymour discovers Audrey II's out of this world origins and intent towards global domination!

**Roles we are casting:**

**Audrey: **She has poor self-worth and education, but a sweet and vulnerable demeanour. Must be comfortable in high heels. All Genders and ethnicities welcome.

Age: 25 to 35

Vocal range top: D5 Vocal range bottom: G#3 Strong belter musical theatre/pop vocal intuition.

Must be a good mover.

**Orin Scrivello: **An egotistical dentist with a passion for leather and sadistic tendencies. Audrey's abusive boyfriend, who is targeted by Seymour. All genders and ethnicities welcome

Age: 25 to 50

Vocal range top: G4 Vocal range bottom: G2 Strong Vocal presence, Slick, Radio Announcer stylings.

Must be a good mover.

**Crystal, Ronnette and Chiffon:** are street urchins, acting as the occasional Greek Chorus. Young, hip, and smart, these three...maybe four are sassy and seriously street smart. All genders and ethnicities welcome. 

Age: 15 to 35

Vocal range top: F5 Vocal range bottom: Ab3 Strong harmony/blending abilities, 50’s pop sensibility. Strong Belts!

These three do a lot of dancing and doo-wop movement.

**Accessibility:** All rehearsal and performances spaces at FIT are accessible, by ground level access. Accessible washrooms are located in all spaces. Uneven ground may be present in the walkways up to the entrance doors. Our performances spaces are all accessible, though smaller doorways may prove to be an access barrier for some mobility aids.

items.text:
# 🎬 CASTING DO PEŁNOMETRAŻOWEGO FILMU FABULARNEGO [NON-PROFIT]

Do niezależnego filmu autorskiego poszukujemy aktorów (zarówno profesjonalistów, jak i osób bez doświadczenia aktorskiego o wyrazistej aparycji) **z Krakowa i okolic**.

📅 **Zdjęcia:** koniec sierpnia – wrzesień 2026
🎥 Zdjęcia realizowane głównie w weekendy. Lokacje znajdują się zarówno w Krakowie, jak i poza miastem.
🚗 **Zapewniamy transport z Krakowa na plan zdjęciowy i z powrotem.**
🍲 Na planie zapewniamy ciepły obiad oraz przyjazną, twórczą atmosferę.
## Poszukujemy:
1. Głuchoniemego mężczyzny

Wiek około **25–45 lat**.

Szukamy osoby o wyrazistej mimice i naturalnej ekspresji. To niewielka, ale bardzo ważna i zapadająca w pamięć rola.
2. Trójki starszych osób do scen w wiejskiej kawiarni

**• Henryk**
70–85 lat. Spokojny starszy mężczyzna o charakterystycznej twarzy. Mile widziane wąsy.

**• Starsza kobieta nr 1**
70–85 lat. Ciepła z wyglądu, z silnym charakterem i subtelnym poczuciem humoru.

**• Starsza kobieta nr 2**
70–85 lat. Bardziej stanowcza, przenikliwa, z ironicznym usposobieniem. Szukamy twarzy z historią.
3. Starsza pani z jabłkami

Wiek **75+**.

Niewielka, ale bardzo ważna scena o filozoficznym charakterze. Szukamy osoby z naturalnością, ciepłem i wewnętrzną głębią.
4. Stara Amalia

Wiek **75–90 lat**.

Jedna z najważniejszych ról drugoplanowych filmu. Finałowa, bardzo emocjonalna scena. Szukamy aktorki potrafiącej przekazać mądrość, czułość i całe przeżyte życie poprzez subtelną obecność przed kamerą.

🎥 **Projekt non-profit.**

Nie szukamy idealnej urody. **Szukamy twarzy z historią.**

Jeśli chcesz wziąć udział w tym projekcie, wyślij na **wegototheseafilm@gmail.com**:

• imię i nazwisko oraz wiek,
• aktualne zdjęcia (portret i cała sylwetka),
• jeśli posiadasz – link do showreela lub wideowizytówki,
• miejscowość zamieszkania oraz numer kontaktowy.

Będziemy wdzięczni za każde udostępnienie. Być może dzięki Tobie znajdziemy naszych bohaterów.

## Poszukujemy:
1. Głuchoniemego mężczyzny

Wiek około **25–45 lat**.

Szukamy osoby o wyrazistej mimice i naturalnej ekspresji. To niewielka, ale bardzo ważna i zapadająca w pamięć rola.
2. Trójki starszych osób do scen w wiejskiej kawiarni

**• Henryk**
70–85 lat. Spokojny starszy mężczyzna o charakterystycznej twarzy. Mile widziane wąsy.

**• Starsza kobieta nr 1**
70–85 lat. Ciepła z wyglądu, z silnym charakterem i subtelnym poczuciem humoru.

**• Starsza kobieta nr 2**
70–85 lat. Bardziej stanowcza, przenikliwa, z ironicznym usposobieniem. Szukamy twarzy z historią.
3. Starsza pani z jabłkami

Wiek **75+**.

Niewielka, ale bardzo ważna scena o filozoficznym charakterze. Szukamy osoby z naturalnością, ciepłem i wewnętrzną głębią.
4. Stara Amalia

Wiek **75–90 lat**.

Jedna z najważniejszych ról drugoplanowych filmu. Finałowa, bardzo emocjonalna scena. Szukamy aktorki potrafiącej przekazać mądrość, czułość i całe przeżyte życie poprzez subtelną obecność przed kamerą.

🎥 **Projekt non-profit.**

Nie szukamy idealnej urody. **Szukamy twarzy z historią.**

Jeśli chcesz wziąć udział w tym projekcie, wyślij na **wegototheseafilm@gmail.com**:

• imię i nazwisko oraz wiek,
• aktualne zdjęcia (portret i cała sylwetka),
• jeśli posiadasz – link do showreela lub wideowizytówki,
• miejscowość zamieszkania oraz numer kontaktowy.

Będziemy wdzięczni za każde udostępnienie. Być może dzięki Tobie znajdziemy naszych bohaterów.

# *****CASTING CREW*** **

**PROJECT TITLE:** *Reincarnation *

**GENRE:** Sci-Fi Fantasy Feature Film Teaser 

**PROJECT TYPE:** Short Film

**PROJECT DESCRIPTION:** A public payphone acts as a machine that lets people experience other worlds; David and Eleonore become trapped in opposite eras (David in a medieval era, Eleonore in the modern one). 

Living in each other’s reality, they learn how society and values change across centuries while their presence threatens history itself. The film is an independent short with sci-fi, fantasy, drama, and romance elements inspired by Black Mirror. 

We are seeking motivated, ambitious, and passionate people who believe in the project and want to help build something meaningful.

**UNION STATUS:** N/A

**LOCATIONS:** Los Angeles area

**PAID: **To be discussed.

**ROLE DESCRIPTION** 

We are looking for motivated, ambitious, and passionate filmmakers to join our independent short film. Crew members should be reliable, creative, collaborative, and committed to bringing the project’s vision to life. Experience is preferred, but passionate emerging filmmakers are welcome. 

**POSITIONS:**

* Camera Operator
* Director of photography
* Gaffer / Lighting Director 
* Sounder Mixer / Recordist 

To apply send an email at:

reincarnationfilmllc@gmail.com

🎬 **CASTING CALL: GRANDMOTHER ROLE | NON-UNION **

We are currently casting a **grandmother role** for an upcoming film production shooting on **August 10 in Middletown, Connecticut**. 

We are looking for a **woman, age 70+**, to play a grandmother attending a summer wedding. 

**Casting Details:**

• **Non-union**
• **Non-paid opportunity**
• **Mileage reimbursement of $0.30 per mile**
• **Filming window: 3:00 PM–8:00 PM**
• Talent must self-report to the filming location in Middletown, Connecticut
• Talent must provide their own **upscale summer wedding attire**
• **Featured role with one speaking line**

The production will feature **Ryan Eggold and Tyler Labine**, known for their roles in the television series *New Amsterdam*.

We are especially looking for someone who can naturally portray a **warm grandmother** at a summer wedding.

If you or someone you know may be interested, please email me at **[madisonparler22@gmail.com](mailto:madisonparler22@gmail.com)**

I'm Ryan Clayton. Ten years of documentary work, and this August I'm directing a narrative thriller short. It's a small, contained, 3 day shoot.

Five roles:

• COREY— lead, plays 30s–40s. A grieving father and husband, pushed past his limit. Carries most of the film.  

• MASKED MAN — physical/stunt role, athletic build.  

• BRAD — supporting. one shoot day.  

• WIFE — supporting, one shoot day.   

• DAUGHTER— supporting, one shoot day. 

Shoots *Aug 21–23* in the Lafayette area. *These are paid roles*. Plus credit, meals every shoot day, and clips for your reel.

# 🎬 CASTING DO PEŁNOMETRAŻOWEGO FILMU FABULARNEGO [NON-PROFIT]

Do niezależnego filmu autorskiego poszukujemy aktorów (zarówno profesjonalistów, jak i osób bez doświadczenia aktorskiego o wyrazistej aparycji) **z Krakowa i okolic**.

📅 **Zdjęcia:** koniec sierpnia – wrzesień 2026
🎥 Zdjęcia realizowane głównie w weekendy. Lokacje znajdują się zarówno w Krakowie, jak i poza miastem.
🚗 **Zapewniamy transport z Krakowa na plan zdjęciowy i z powrotem.**
🍲 Na planie zapewniamy ciepły obiad oraz przyjazną, twórczą atmosferę.
## Poszukujemy:
1. Głuchoniemego mężczyzny

Wiek około **25–45 lat**.

Szukamy osoby o wyrazistej mimice i naturalnej ekspresji. To niewielka, ale bardzo ważna i zapadająca w pamięć rola.
2. Trójki starszych osób do scen w wiejskiej kawiarni

**• Henryk**
70–85 lat. Spokojny starszy mężczyzna o charakterystycznej twarzy. Mile widziane wąsy.

**• Starsza kobieta nr 1**
70–85 lat. Ciepła z wyglądu, z silnym charakterem i subtelnym poczuciem humoru.

**• Starsza kobieta nr 2**
70–85 lat. Bardziej stanowcza, przenikliwa, z ironicznym usposobieniem. Szukamy twarzy z historią.
3. Starsza pani z jabłkami

Wiek **75+**.

Niewielka, ale bardzo ważna scena o filozoficznym charakterze. Szukamy osoby z naturalnością, ciepłem i wewnętrzną głębią.
4. Stara Amalia

Wiek **75–90 lat**.

Jedna z najważniejszych ról drugoplanowych filmu. Finałowa, bardzo emocjonalna scena. Szukamy aktorki potrafiącej przekazać mądrość, czułość i całe przeżyte życie poprzez subtelną obecność przed kamerą.

🎥 **Projekt non-profit.**

Nie szukamy idealnej urody. **Szukamy twarzy z historią.**

Jeśli chcesz wziąć udział w tym projekcie, wyślij na **wegototheseafilm@gmail.com**:

• imię i nazwisko oraz wiek,
• aktualne zdjęcia (portret i cała sylwetka),
• jeśli posiadasz – link do showreela lub wideowizytówki,
• miejscowość zamieszkania oraz numer kontaktowy.

Będziemy wdzięczni za każde udostępnienie. Być może dzięki Tobie znajdziemy naszych bohaterów.

📅 17-19 sierpnia

DRIADY (18-30 lat)

ZAKAPTURZENI (20-35 lat)

Hello everyone 👋
DO YOU OR ANYONE YOU KNOW ASPIRE TO GO TO DRAMA SCHOOL? ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

There are 5 places available to people who want to apply to & gain a place at the top UK Drama Schools. (Any level from Foundation, BA or Postgrad) 

I helped people gain 12 offers this year with 100% recall rate and I’d LOVE to help you this coming year too. 

I’ve 30 YEARS EXPERIENCE of training actors at drama schools, theatres & on my own private courses. In the past 3 yrs alone I have helped people gain places at over 15 top institutions (see image below for the list of schools)

Hey all — Simon Lopez here, I run A&G Studio. Wanted to introduce myself to this group.

Putting myself out there for work. Producing, directing, shooting, second unit, audio post — happy to jump on other people’s projects, wherever they are.

Twenty years in production. Came up in CBS Radio production in New York and DC, spent a decade producing for agencies, and have run my own shop since 2014. Work has included TikTok, Amazon Prime’s The Boys drone show, McDonald’s, Penn Entertainment, and the Vegas Golden Knights. My documentary De Lo Alto is in the festival circuit right now.

I also package films — script breakdowns, line budgets, and investor decks. If you’ve got a feature you’re trying to get financed and need the numbers to hold up in front of money, that’s work I do.

Fully bilingual, English and Spanish.

And it runs both ways: we produce nationally, so I’m always building out my crew bench — DPs, ACs, gaffers, grips, audio, drone operators, editors. Wherever you’re working, I’d like to know you. Drop your reel below.

Reach out any time — simon@angstudiolv.com

items.text:
CASTING CALL – Children – Non-Speaking Product Video - Paid

I'm casting for a non-speaking product video featuring creative building toys similar to LEGO-style construction sets. Non-union.

I'm looking for the following roles:

Role 1 - Female, Age 7-12, Black ethnicity

Role 2 - Male, Age 5-8, Black ethnicity

Ideal Candidates
* Outgoing, confident personalities who enjoy playing with toys
* Able to follow simple direction and stay engaged during filming
* Comfortable in front of the camera
* Previous modeling or acting experience is welcome, but not required
* Siblings or friends would be preferred but not required.

Project Details
* Non-speaking role
* Small-scale, two-person production team in a relaxed, low-stress environment
* The two children will likely be needed for 1–2 hours, though filming may extend up to 4 hours

Pay: $50 CAD/hour (3-hour minimum guaranteed) — Minimum booking of $150 per child

A fun opportunity to earn some extra money, gain on-camera experience, and try something new during summer break!

Filming Schedule

Dates: TBD (sometime in within the next two weeks)

Location: Lower Mainland, BC (exact location TBD, likely surrey or White Rock)

I'm currently building my talent roster and will work around everyone's availability when scheduling filming.

Usage

The finished videos will be published digitally across the client's Amazon listings, website,brand store, social media channels, and other online advertising platforms.

Important Note

Per my client's request and for confidentiality purposes, the finished videos cannot be released to the talent or used for personal portfolios or demo reels.

Parent/Guardian Requirement

A parent or legal guardian must remain on set for the duration of filming for all child participants.

Interested?

Please email the following to runestonepics@gmail.com :
* Child's name, age, and gender
* A few recent photos (phone photos are perfectly fine)
* General availability over the summer
* Any previous modeling or acting experience (optional)

Subject Line: Child Casting Role # – (Age, Gender)

Example: Child Casting Role #1 – 10, Female

Selected applicants will be contacted with additional project details, filming dates, and a model release form.

I look forward to hearing from you

Do jednego z ostatnich odcinków 21. sezonu serialu „Gliniarze”, realizowanego w Warszawie (i bliskich okolicach) poszukuję nastolatka do roli:

-Julek (17) – Wydaje mu się, że przez to, że ojciec jest znanym prawnikiem, to jemu wszystko wolno.
Data: 20 i 22.08
Stawka: 1200 zł netto za całość

Chętnych Panów zapraszam do wysyłania PILNYCH zgłoszeń na adres: casting.outset@interia.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila proszę o wpisanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. Do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Informację kiedy ostatnio grali Państwo w serialu „Gliniarze” 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

Vi søger medvirkende til en mindre kampagne for et stor Dansk Turistbureau.

Optagelse: 2. + 3. september - Halve dage
Honorar: Voksen 3.000 kr. / Barn 1.500 kr.

**Vi søger følgende:**

**En familie**
* Mor
* Far
* Datter (5–14 år)
* Søn (5–14 år)

**Et ungt par**
* Ung kvinde i 20’erne
* Ung mand i 20’erne

Det er ikke et krav, at familien er en ægte familie, eller at parret er et rigtigt par, men det er klart en fordel, hvis relationen føles naturlig.

**Locations:**

D. 2. september – Nordhavn
D. 3. september – Dragør

**Ansøgning:**

Send følgende:
• Et par nyere billeder
• Alder på alle medvirkende
• Dit telefonnummer

Skriv til mbbutlercasting@gmail.com med emnet **Turist**.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

🎬 STATISTER SØGES TIL KORTFILMEN "EN DEL AF LEGEN"
Har du lyst til at være statist i en psykologisk thriller/drama, der er inspireret af en virkelig hændelse?

Vi søger statister til optagelserne af kortfilmen En del af legen, som finder sted på Sluseholmen (KBH) den 16. august.

Om filmen

30-årige Mikkel skal mødes med en kvinde, han har lært at kende gennem en datingapp. Hun inviterer ham hjem til et aftalt rollespil, hvor hun sætter alle reglerne. En af dem lyder:

"Hvis jeg skriger, skal du ikke stoppe. Det er bare en del af legen."

Mikkel tror, han ved, hvad han går ind til. Men da legen begynder, bryder virkeligheden sammen, og fortidens traumer får fatale konsekvenser.

Praktisk

📍 Mødested: Sluseholmen, København SV

🕓 Tid: Kl. 16.00 – ca. 20 (der tages forbehold for mindre ændringer, da det endelige dagprogram endnu ikke er færdigt)

Hvad skal du lave?

I filmens åbningsscene skaber du liv i gadebilledet hvor Mikkel introduceres.

I den efterfølgende scene ved en café skal nogle statister sidde ved cafébordene, mens andre passerer på fortovet, så området fremstår levende og naturligt.

Deltagelse er ulønnet, men vi sørger selvfølgelig for snacks og drikkevarer under optagelserne.

Hvis du har lyst til at være med, så send en mail til burcuucler@gmail.com – vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

items.text: Ich laufe trauernd durch den Kölner Rheinauhafen und ihr hört meinen Text samt meiner Stimme: https://www.facebook.com/share/v/1EfRUWLJnz/ Ich freue mich über euer Feedback 🎬 Christian Weiße

sharedPost.text:
Jeder Schritt schmerzt anders

Ich gehe heute allein durch den Rheinauhafen. Über Wege, die in den vergangenen zwei Jahren der Parcours, der Abenteuerspielplatz und die kleine große Welt unserer Aussiedoodle-Hündin Mayla waren. Jede Treppe, jede Mauer und jeder Geruch gehörten zu ihren Entdeckungen. Sie sprang, schnupperte, lernte und verwandelte jeden Spaziergang in ein gemeinsames Abenteuer.

Doch Mayla ist nicht mehr hier. Sie lebt jetzt an einem anderen Ort, zusammen mit der Frau, mit der ich fünfzehn Jahre meines Lebens geteilt habe. Der Frau, deren Hand ich auf all diesen Wegen gehalten habe, während ich in der anderen Maylas Hundeleine trug. Meine Partnerin auf der einen Seite, unser FellBaby auf der anderen. Genau so fühlte sich mein Leben vollständig an.

Nach der Trennung hätte ich niemals um Mayla streiten können. Nicht, weil sie mir weniger bedeutet, sondern weil ich beide so sehr liebe, dass ich aus unserem FellBaby keinen Gegenstand eines Kampfes machen konnte. Ich hätte es nicht ertragen, Mayla zwischen zwei Menschen zu ziehen, die einmal ihr gemeinsames Zuhause waren. Also blieb mir nur, loszulassen, obwohl sich in mir alles dagegen wehrt.

Jetzt gehe ich diese Wege ohne ihre Hand und ohne Maylas Leine. Jeder Schritt erinnert mich daran, was fehlt. Jeder Atemzug trägt Bilder, Stimmen und Augenblicke in sich, die noch immer lebendig sind, obwohl unser gemeinsames Leben nicht mehr existiert.

Ich frage mich, wie lange dieser Ort noch meine Gegenwart sein kann. Ob Köln und der Rheinauhafen noch eine Zukunft für mich bereithalten oder ob ich gehen muss, weil hier jede Minute zu einhundert Prozent mit ihnen verbunden ist.

Vielleicht ist Trauer genau das: weiterzugehen, obwohl jeder vertraute Weg plötzlich weh tut.

We’re looking for a German actor (fluent in English) for a short mini-series filming in **Vilnius, Lithuania, on August 14–15**.

The project is a **tourism campaign for social media (Instagram Reels & TikTok).**

**About the project:**
The story follows three university friends from different countries who decide to get away for a weekend in Vilnius. The series shows their adventures and experiences during the trip.

**Role:**
**Hans – an artist from Berlin**
German, fluent in English.

If you’re interested or know someone who could be a good fit, please send me a DM with your **photos, showreel/acting experience and contact details**.

Feel free to share with anyone who might be interested.
